levels.surface: محمد بن الحسن بن أحمد بن الوليد

notes: «عَنْ أَخِيهِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَهْزِيَارَ»: «أخيه» plus a name is one link, the name alone (rule 7).

Husayn ibn Khalid asks the Imam while Hasan narrates «وأنا حاضر»: the asker is only in the scene (rule 5), so he is not a link; the Imam answers and is the last link, named in the words after the chain (owner ruling 2).
